name: ATM Deposit Completion Acknowledgement V 02
definition: The ATMDepositCompletionAcknowledgement message is sent by an acquirer or its agent to an ATM to acknowledge the receipt of an ATMDepositCompletionAdvice message.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

ATMDepositCompletionAcknowledgement.name: ATM Deposit Completion Acknowledgement
ATMDepositCompletionAcknowledgement.definition: Information related to the acknowledgement of an ATM deposit transaction from the ATM manager.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC.
